pr_comments: `EDITOR_DEF` should be changed to `EDITOR_DEF_RST` for all 3D editor gizmos, not just CSG. (I believe these all require a restart to make the changes visible.)
Why does this need an editor restart in the first place? This should be something we can update on the fly, surely?
It could be updated on the fly yes, that's just more work :P
Thanks! It doesn't look like we're going to address the restart issue soon, so this is a good PR to have in the meantime.

> It could be updated on the fly yes

Yes it would require recreate the material after the color is changed. If there is a convient way of get notifed after the color is changed in project setting, it'd doable and should be pretty straight forward. 

But many gizmo color are used in `EditorNode3DGizmoPlugin` , it's not a `Node` so no  `NOTIFICATION_EDITOR_SETTINGS_CHANGED` for them.

issue_context.title: Missing prompt to restart editor when 3D Gizmo color editor settings changed
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.1.2

### System information

Windows 10

### Issue description

Changes to `Editor Settings -> Editors -> 3D Gizmos`, which require an editor restart to take effect, do not prompt "The editor must be restarted for changes to take effect.". Contrast this with changes to `Editor Settings -> Editors -> 3D -> Selection Box Color`, which does prompt the user to restart the editor (and helpfully provides a button to do so).

Screenshot from before restarting editor to apply changes. Note the unchanged selection color of the CSG box, and the lack of a prompt to restart the editor.
![Godot_v4 1 2-stable_mono_win64_tuwiwlMJnb](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/145553014/65aaeafa-0c41-4f03-944f-a5b43c73bf58)




### Steps to reproduce

Add a 3D scene. Add a CSGBox3D. Save the scene.
Select the box, observe the default blue tint. Deselect the box.
Change `Editor Settings -> Editors -> 3D Gizmos -> CSG` to `#ff0000`. Observe the lack of a prompt to restart the editor.
Select the box, observe the _unchanged_ default blue tint. Deselect the box.
Restart the editor.
Select the box, observe the correct, changed red tint.

### Minimal reproduction project

N/A

review_comments: I believe so, as there is a editor setting cache mechanism, we have to set the restart_if_changed if the value is directly read from `EDITOR_GET`.
